summary: Sells thematic tech as 12+ single-theme certificates plus a UCITS umbrella. Leans on research heritage since 2004, a 1,300-sub-sector taxonomy and its AI/quant platform Fundy. Product pages are ungated and show price, YTD and ISIN; the factsheet gives monthly net returns and fees. Tone is marketing-heavy and pitched broadly.

A long-only multi-thematic growth UCITS (EUR 139m) tilted to tech (~52% IT, ~35% AI infrastructure) with a mid-cap/healthcare barbell. Promoted through PM interviews; full-performance factsheets are public even though fund pages sit behind an investor-category gate. Multilingual and institutional in tone.

The scale benchmark: Robotics alone is EUR 13bn. Every share class has a standardised page with NAV, size, SRI, benchmark-relative returns and a full document library. TR-Atlas Titan (EUR 688m) is the closest TMS analogue, a discretionary global L/S that is not tech-specific.

The only tech long/short with a behavioural-sentiment quant overlay in the Swiss set, a real positioning gap. But the gated page has no ISIN, vehicle, fees, AUM, performance, documents or team, and its only proof point is a 2023 'Managed Futures' award. The public /investment intro now reads more quant than the gated page.
